question: In which of the following months is the Konark Dance festival organised in Odisha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**December**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Konark Dance Festival is held annually in December.
 
• This festival takes place at the Konark Sun Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
 
• It showcases classical dance forms such as Odissi, Bharatnatyam, Kathak, Kuchipudi, and Manipuri.
 
• The festival attracts renowned dancers and artists from across India and the world.
 
• It is organized by the Odisha Tourism Development Corporation (OTDC).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Odissi Dance**

 
 
• Odissi is one of the oldest classical dance forms in India, originating from Odisha.
 
• It is known for its fluid movements and expressive gestures.
 
• The dance is characterized by its distinct poses and intricate footwork.
 
• Odissi is performed predominantly by women, although there are male dancers as well.
 
 
 
• **Konark Sun Temple**
 
 
• The Konark Sun Temple was built in the 13th century by King Narasimhadeva I of the Eastern Ganga dynasty.
 
• It is dedicated to the Sun God and is designed in the shape of a gigantic chariot.
 
• The temple is famous for its intricate stone carvings and architectural grandeur.
 
• It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the major tourist attractions in Odisha.
 
 
 
• **UNESCO World Heritage Sites**
 
 
• These are landmarks or areas recognized by the United Nations Educational, Scientific, and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) for their cultural, historical, scientific, or other forms of significance.
 
• The purpose is to safeguard and preserve these sites for future generations.
 
• India has several UNESCO World Heritage Sites, including the Taj Mahal, Qutub Minar, and Ajanta Caves.
 
• The Konark Sun Temple is one of the UNESCO World Heritage Sites in India.
 
 
 
• **Odisha Tourism Development Corporation (OTDC)**
 
 
• OTDC is a government organization responsible for promoting tourism in Odisha.
 
• It organizes various cultural festivals and events to attract tourists.
 
• OTDC provides amenities and services for tourists visiting the state.
 
• The Konark Dance Festival is one of the major events organized by OTDC.
